title: Random Trio #07 (금박+임산부+보태니컬)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Gold Leaf): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — full body applied ELECTRIC MAGENTA leaf covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Thin irregular metallic sheets — BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA leaf with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID SILVER undertone glinting through the thinnest points, a soft warm metallic sheen filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: back three-quarter turned, face over shoulder direct eye contact, bubble butt projected backward — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: platform boots 8 inch, extra long stiletto nails to match.

#2 (Pregnant): Korean, in her late 30s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — and between them, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward, her waistline already soft and gently defined even without the pregnancy, now continuing that same soft fullness into the belly's round curve with no harsh transition anywhere. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, long sleek black hair, a cold, commanding gaze, bright golden-blonde hair styled in a chin-length bob, real pores, real living eyes, 100 segment rings piercings set with sapphires in bronze-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of rose-gold a necklace. Painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern, a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle, wide magenta-and-gold bands curving fully around her belly, the densest concentration of geometric diamond work wrapping the belly as centrepiece and continuing over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, extreme magenta-and-gold plain stiletto pumps.

#3 (Botanical): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, hair threaded through with real trailing vines — full body living lotus growing directly from her own skin covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, not a dress, every stem rooted directly into her living skin and every petal standing up in true three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. BLAZING PINK lotus blossoms in full three-dimensional bloom, VIVID JADE leaves and curling tendrils filling every remaining gap with real depth and texture, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: extreme platform heels entirely overgrown with the same living lotus blooms and vines, extra long nails with tiny petals embedded at each tip.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 3, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio.
